question: Can the accepted R16 RGBD checkpoint be reused as a limited development instance baseline with a deterministic metric-depth interface?
scope: Supervised one-round baseline reuse; not repair of R18 weights, held-out validation, full P4 completion, full P6, or method superiority.

parent_protocol.scope: Paired RGB/RGBD development baseline from scratch; not a complete mask-AP or quality-aware method study
parent_protocol.initialization: Identical randomly initialized shared RGB stem/backbone/heads; extra RGBD depth and validity convolution weights zero; reset all RNG streams after model construction; no learned checkpoint inherited
limitations: All ten nontraining scenes were previously used for development; no independent confirmation or test generalization claim.
One seed, 320x240 early fusion pilot architecture, ten epochs; does not complete the original full-resolution dual-stream or multiple-seed plan.
Instance F1 at IoU0.50 is not mask AP, AP50 or AP75; no grasp scoring or real robot outcomes.
RGBD adds 6272 trainable first-convolution parameters; the input-modality comparison includes this difference.
No degradation, quality head, uncertainty propagation, probability calibration, extra epochs, threshold search or best-checkpoint selection.
Independent acceptance recomputes counts from cached predictions; it does not independently reproduce the neural forward pass.

selection_rule: Frame 0000 in every existing 20 training and 10 previously exposed development scene. Fixed by identity before any new outcome; no outcome-driven selection.
missing_depth_policy: Record/exclude invalid-depth pixels; never invent depth. Require at least one matched instance with valid depth per frame.
stop_rule: Exactly one run and one zero-forward full readonly verification. Stop afterwards regardless of scientific outcome; technical failure also stops. No retry, follow-on experiment, training, or automation without new user confirmation.
counts_scope: 30 new actual returned model calls maximum. Historical calls are not relabelled as new. Historical R18 two unknown outcomes remain unknown. Constructor RNG is technical initialization, not Monte Carlo scientific sampling.
